name: 06514 · Hamden, CT
findings: ZIP 06514 (Hamden) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06514 (Hamden) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
